scenario_name: 2 omitted dimensions; intended use: Spring section (Sezione primavera)
initial_query: I am looking for an existing school building. I intend to create a spring section (sezione primavera), integrated into an existing kindergarten. The location is in Turin. I need a property with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 14 people.
submitted_query: I am looking for an existing school building. I intend to create a spring section (sezione primavera), integrated into an existing kindergarten. The location is in Turin. I need a property with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 14 people.
final_sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Attività scolastiche' AND surface_area >= 180 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

scenario_definition.oracle_query: Find an existing school building to create a spring section (sezione primavera) for 14 children, integrated into an existing kindergarten in Turin with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.

requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 180 sqm of gross floor area, so this is a direct minimum surface filter. The capacity of 14 people is not converted into a surface requirement, since no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was provided.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Attività scolastiche' AND surface_area >= 180 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters for school-type properties (property_type = 'Attività scolastiche') with surface_area >= 180 sqm, located within 3.0 km of the given coordinates (45.0677551, 7.6824892) using haversine distance on latitude/longitude. Results are ordered by ascending distance from that point. The 14-person capacity requirement is not among the extracted requirements and has no matching filterable column, so it is not applied.
